measurement_script:
from pathlib import Path
import os,json,re,subprocess,hashlib,statistics,time
from tools.sloppy_core.benchmark_apps import prepare_source,execute
root=Path('__dewycache__/task-tmp/web-kernel-tiering').resolve()
compiler=Path('__dewycache__/compact-core/build-1792330364134074469/bin/dewy-core').resolve()
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('DEWY_','SLOPPY_'))};env.update(SLOPPY_EMIT_WORKERS='1',SLOPPY_THREADS='1')
flags={'normal':[],'optimizing':['--no-liftoff'],'baseline':['--liftoff-only']}
report={'compiler':str(compiler),'compiler_sha256':hashlib.sha256(compiler.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'node':subprocess.check_output(['node','--version'],text=True).strip(),'cpu_affinity':list(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),'node_flags':flags,'workloads':{},'limits':['Same release WebAssembly artifact per workload; fresh Node process per sample, three alternating samples.', 'Node engine flags diagnose tiering; they are not browser deployment settings.', 'Canonical workloads at 10000000; initialization excluded from kernel timer but included in wall time.']}
for name in ['text','arrays']:
 source=prepare_source(name,root);artifact=root/f'{name}.html'
 built=subprocess.run([compiler,'build',source,'--target','wasm','--release','-o',artifact],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
 assert built.returncode==0,built.stdout+built.stderr
 runner=artifact.with_suffix('.cjs');runner.write_text('const sloppyArgs=process.argv.slice(1);\n'+'\n'.join(re.findall(r'<script[^>]*>(.*?)</script>',artifact.read_text(),re.S)))
 rows={label:[] for label in flags};checks=set()
 for i in range(3):
  for label in (list(flags) if i%2==0 else list(flags)[::-1]):
   checksum,timing=execute(['node',*flags[label],runner],10000000,env);checks.add(checksum);rows[label].append(timing)
 assert len(checks)==1,checks
 group={'source':source.read_text(),'artifact_sha256':hashlib.sha256(artifact.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'checksum':checks.pop(),'samples':rows,'median_kernel_ms':{label:statistics.median(r['kernel_ns'] for r in samples)/1e6 for label,samples in rows.items()}}
 report['workloads'][name]=group;print(name,group['median_kernel_ms'],flush=True)
 (root/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
